title: The Relics of General Chasse: A Tale of Antwerp
sourceTitle: The Relics of General Chasse: A Tale of Antwerp
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "The Relics of General Chassé: A Tale of Antwerp" by Anthony Trollope is a novella that falls within the genre of historical fiction, written during the mid-19th century, a time characterized by the Victorian era's social and literary developments.
longDescription: The story focuses on the aftermath of a significant historical event: the siege of Antwerp where General Chassé, a key figure in the Dutch defense, is celebrated despite his defeat.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
